notes.content: The Subject Matter Preparation Program for Mathematics fulfills subject matter competency prerequisite for entrance into a credential program for a single subject teaching credential in mathematics. The Mathematics Subject Matter Preparation Program (SMPP) is oriented to teaching mathematics, approved by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing, and satisfies the subject matter prerequisites for entry into a single subject credential program to teach mathematics. This program fulfills subject matter competency prerequisite for entrance into a credential program for a single subject teaching credential in mathematics. A student must meet specified academic standards to obtain department certification for having completed the Mathematics Subject Matter Preparation Program. Please contact the Department of Mathematics for more information. Students intending to enter the Credential Program should consult the Teacher Education section of the Academic Catalog for additional requirements. Please note that this is an optional waiver program and a track in the Mathematics B.A.
